notes: The document converter now installs properly. On some computers setup reported that the converter could not be started when it had in fact installed correctly, and a console window appeared first asking for a key press. Both are fixed, and the converter is now proved to work by converting a document rather than by reading a version number. Setup also skips the converter step altogether when LibreOffice is already on the computer, and a gateway key that is already saved is filled in on the connect step rather than left blank. Four smaller fixes around installing it: the download progress runs to completion instead of reaching 100% early and appearing to stall, an install is no longer abandoned when Windows is busy with another installation, removing the converter reports honestly whether it was removed, and the free-space check matches what the install actually needs.
